description: On Friday, May 19, the Northport Journal held its inaugural Sunset Gala. The three-hour event celebrated people who make a positive impact on our Northport-East Northport community, “the doers and the changers, the visionaries and the voices who have stepped forward to make a difference.” And what a night it was.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Dave Weber
title: Success! First-ever Sunset Gala shines light on community, compassion and action - Trustee Dave Weber Jr.
